arguments:
{"script":"set -e
mkdir -p temp_workspace
# Capture environment snapshot
env > temp_workspace/env_snapshot.txt
# Gather possible npm locations: command -v -a plus find in standard bin dirs
{ command -v -a npm 2>/dev/null || true; } > /tmp/_npm_cmds
find /bin /usr/bin /usr/local/bin /sbin /usr/sbin /opt /snap/bin -maxdepth 2 -type f -name 'npm' -print 2>/dev/null > /tmp/_npm_find || true
cat /tmp/_npm_cmds /tmp/_npm_find | grep -v '^$' | sort -u > temp_workspace/candidates.txt || true
# Prepare metadata file
: > temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  printf 'Path: %s\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then printf 'Exists: yes\n' >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt; else printf 'Exists: no\n' >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt; fi
  if [ -x "$p" ]; then printf 'Executable: yes\n' >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt; else printf 'Executable: no\n' >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt; fi
  file "$p" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/Type: /' >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt || true
  ls -l "$p" 2>/dev/null >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt || true
  # Try to get a short identification/version output if possible
  idout=$({ "$p" --version 2>/dev/null || "$p" -v 2>/dev/null || true; } 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$idout" ]; then printf 'Identification: %s\n' "$(echo "$idout" | head -n1)" >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt; else printf 'Identification: (none)\n' >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt; fi
  printf '---\n' >> temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt
# Consolidate check_ready
exists_flag=no
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -x "$p" ]; then exists_flag=yes; break; fi
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt
printf '%s\n' "${exists_flag}" > temp_workspace/check_ready.txt
printf 'details: %s, %s\n' "temp_workspace/candidates.txt" "temp_workspace/candidates_metadata.txt" >> temp_workspace/check_ready.txt
# Output final simple answer to stdout
printf '%s' "${exists_flag}"
"}
